Full summary: Re-review APPROVED for merge; took the three fix-at-leisure regressions now (R1 unknown-id cross-links stay in place with inline message via a limit=1 neighborhood probe, graph entities still open the explorer; R2 cross-link = one history entry + facets preserved; R3 dead renderers fetchDecisionDetail/renderBlackboardDetail/renderGraphDetail + exports deleted) plus the pre-existing overview/ego fetch race (monotonic nav epoch guard in graph-view). All browser-verified; suite 1173 green.
Decisions: Took R1-R3 + race guard immediately instead of deferring — ~30 lines in files just touched, zero delivery-time impact (the cheap-adjacent-fix criterion); deferring would have shipped two user-visible cross-linking regressions.; Unknown-id resolution probes /api/graph/neighborhood with limit=1 before navigating — one cheap request per cross-link click buys never yanking the user off their current tab for a dead id. The browser logs the probe's 404 in the console (network log, not an exception) — cosmetic and accepted.
